questions.text: What is the locus of points equidistant from two fixed points A and B?
options: The perpendicular bisector of the line segment AB
A circle with AB as diameter
questions.explanation: The perpendicular bisector of the line segment AB is the standard locus for this condition.

questions.text: What is the locus of points equidistant from two intersecting straight lines?
options: The perpendicular bisector of the lines
A single line parallel to both
The pair of lines bisecting the angles between them
questions.explanation: The pair of lines bisecting the angles between them is the standard locus for this condition.

questions.text: What is the locus of a point that moves so that it is always a fixed distance r from a fixed point O?

The centroid, found where the medians meet
